title: Eligibility to Launch an IPO in India: SEBI Rules for Mainboard and SME IPOs (2026)
seoTitle: Eligibility to Launch an IPO in India: SEBI Rules 2026
seoDescription: SEBI IPO eligibility in 2026: ₹3 crore net tangible assets, ₹15 crore average profit or the 75% QIB route, promoter lock-in, public float and SME rules.
excerpt: Which companies can launch an IPO in India? SEBI's profitability and QIB routes, promoter lock-in, the minimum public offer revised in March 2026, and the tighter SME IPO rules from 2025, explained simply.
